frozen: The thirteen burden names and their human-facing display order.
The rule that the display order is a coarse conformance view over a typed causal hypergraph, not a claim of thirteen atomic runtime states.
The requirement that each mapped carrier retain its own type, standing, identity, cardinality, and non-conversions.
The eight-surface BecomingView projection defined in this crosswalk.
The promotion-and-collapse conservation pair, with its genealogy preserved.
not_frozen: A monolithic service or new organ.
A claim that every existing profile implements all thirteen burdens in one route.
The unresolved front-edge adapter, cross-package return adapter, or colliding type names.
Production, canon, external-effect, or mathematical-proof standing.

cardinality_rules: ONE-RCC F0.1 binds one AttemptAdmission to one exact authorized attempt identity.
TOP F0.1 separately permits one AttemptAdmission to govern zero or many ExecutionAttempt records; this is a profile collision, not an equivalence.
TOP permits one attempt to yield zero or many occurrences, one occurrence to yield zero or many observations, and one observation to yield zero or many receipts.
Inheritance is optional and occurs only after an independently based admitting disposition.
joins: ONE-RCC branches an occurrence into a semantic receipt/candidate path and an observation/evidence/runtime-receipt path; both meet at the RuntimeCandidateGate.
ONE V1 joins Proof Return, SourcePoint Fit Return, and SourcePoint disposition before any InheritanceRecord or successor context exists.
recurrent_regions: Return and reconstruction may recur as later evidence or improved resolution arrives.
Settlement may remain OPEN or UNSETTLED and re-enter review without rewriting prior return records.
A deliberate rerun creates a new attempt identity and recursively reconstructible lineage; transport retry is not rerun.
conditional_edges: Prepared possibility reaches crossing only after separate SourcePoint choice and separate authorization.
Observation reaches evidence standing only through an independent EvidenceAssessment.
Settlement reaches recognized successor standing only under the applicable admission rule.

genealogy.claim: The corpus already contains typed causal graphs, formal operators and judgments, frozen experimental grammars, executable single-edge passage semantics, trace-sensitive reconstruction, return, settlement, and inheritance carriers.

The distributed carriers jointly form one temporal conformance surface from prepared possibility through conditional successor admission, although no prior artifact names the exact thirteen-burden whole.
The exact thirteen-burden Becoming Spine, the eight-surface BecomingView, and the pairing of no-silent-promotion with no-premature-collapse are introduced by this reconciliation.

laws.name: No Silent Promotion
laws.statement: No artifact acquires a higher type, standing, authority, evidence status, settlement status, or successor status without the explicit typed transition and distinct record required by its governing profile.

laws.name: No Premature Collapse
laws.statement: A profile may compose operations atomically only when each operation's input, output, authority basis, standing effect, temporal position, trace, and failure semantics remain separately recoverable.

laws.name: Promotion-Collapse Conservation Pair
laws.statement: Standing may not increase without an explicit typed transition; consequential differentiation may not decrease without action-relative adequacy.

stages.name: Possibility
stages.definition: Carry differentiated possible futures without treating any candidate as inevitable, chosen, authorized, or executable.

carriers.role: Holds the bounded candidate population from which prospective preparation is formed.
Holds sealed dormant candidates, assumptions, provenance, uncertainty, expiry, and invalidation conditions with consequence standing NONE.
carriers.scope: Candidate research contract; no runtime service or schema is asserted.

carriers.role: Predicates that a live possibility field was faithfully reconstituted without implying choice, authorization, or execution.
carriers.scope: Frozen RGCB field predicate, not an eighth operator.

stages.name: Preparation
stages.definition: Form, preserve, correspond, revalidate, and orient prepared material while keeping its zero-egress and non-authoritative standing explicit.

carriers.role: Records bounded formation or evaluation used to prepare candidate responses.
Seals time, source, profile, candidate population, feature definitions, expiry, invalidation rules, and exposure lineage.
carriers.scope: A preparation-custody seal; not SourcePoint commitment or execution commitment.

stages.name: Choice
stages.definition: Record the SourcePoint decision to author or decline an exact intent without inheriting standing from a prepared candidate or bearing.

carriers.role: Binds the human decision, action, target, payload, candidate, bearing, signature basis, and time.
Offers a non-authoritative candidate for SourcePoint choice with choiceEffect and authorityEffect NONE.

stages.name: Commitment
stages.definition: Bind human authorship, an exact proposal, permitted change, dependencies, and point-of-use conditions without conflating preparation seals, authorship, execution commitment, or consequence-time commit.

carriers.role: Records SourcePoint-authored intent and its exact origin without deriving authority from the prior bearing.
Binds the exact proposal, authority derivation, translator, dependency root, intended and permitted deltas, required coverage, validity interval, and policy.
Binds an exact consequence-time crossing to the current expected head.

stages.notes: Commitment is a burden family with separately qualified types, not one universal record.

stages.name: Attempt
stages.definition: Admit and record attributable execution attempts with exact identity, current authority, retry/rerun distinction, and reconstructible lineage.

carriers.role: Binds one exact admitted attempt identity and requires a new admission and operation key for deliberate rerun.
Carries proposal-bound attempt entitlement, point-of-use currentness, and zero-to-many attempt cardinality under the TOP profile.

stages.notes: The same AttemptAdmission label carries incompatible one-attempt and zero-to-many-attempt profiles; no cross-profile substitution is permitted.

stages.name: Occurrence
stages.definition: Identify and bind consequential effects separately from the attempt, later observation, and endpoint state.

carriers.role: Binds a semantic occurrence claim to the exact runtime attempt and actual-delta claims.
Represents a separately identified consequential effect attributable to one ExecutionAttempt.

stages.name: Consequence
stages.definition: Keep intended, authorized, actual, observed, unresolved, and supportable deltas distinct through consequence assessment.

carriers.role: Preserves authorized, occurred, observed, unobserved, and unresolved delta surfaces for later settlement.
Accounts for one confined local effect and returns its bounded consequence material.

stages.name: Witness
stages.definition: Produce an attributable bounded observation while preserving coverage, uncertainty, and the distinction between seeing, evidencing, and settling.

carriers.role: Binds observed delta, actual coverage, witness identity, and observation time to an exact occurrence binding.
Represents partial or uncertain observation of one or more occurrences with no automatic evidence or standing effect.

stages.name: Evidence
stages.definition: Assess admitted observations and receipts under an independent evidence basis without converting integrity, coverage, or coherence into truth.

carriers.role: Assesses unexpected, unconfirmed, and missing delta/coverage surfaces against the exact commitment and observation.
Binds observations and receipts under an independent admission basis and separates evidence strength from succession disposition.
Carries bounded stage evidence into Proof Return without inheriting upstream success as standing.
carriers.scope: ONE V1 bounded and stacked assemblies.

stages.name: Return
stages.definition: Carry an attributable account of attempt, occurrence, observation, evidence, outcome, and unresolved remainder back to a disposition point.

carriers.role: Keeps semantic translation and runtime evidence postures distinct before the candidate gate.
Integrity-binds one or more observations without establishing truth, evidence admission, settlement, or standing.
Returns attributable material while preserving unresolved delivery, outcome, collateral effect, or settlement burdens.
carriers.scope: Frozen RGCB grammar and executable bounded specimens.

carriers.role: Returns bounded evidence material to SourcePoint Fit and disposition.
carriers.scope: ONE V1 bounded and stacked assemblies.

stages.name: Reconstruction
stages.definition: Reconstruct an attributable higher-order account from exact-bound traces and returns without creating evidence, authority, recovery, or successor standing.

carriers.role: Reconstructs retry/rerun lineage under one proposal and commitment while preserving each attempt identity.
Produces a deterministic bounded reconstructed view or typed hold from provenance-preserving material.
carriers.scope: Formal build candidate with a bounded 70-test implementation surface.

carriers.role: Supports trace-sensitive constitutional assessment and reconstruction without retroactively changing what occurred.

stages.name: Settlement
stages.definition: Adjudicate returned and reconstructed material into a bounded judgment and control disposition while preserving OPEN, UNSETTLED, DENIED, QUARANTINED, and admitted states as distinct.

carriers.role: Assesses destination burdens and produces a separately typed standing decision before a standing effect specification exists.
Separates succession judgment, control disposition, and effective successor state; absent decision yields UNSETTLED.
Preserves procedural RECORDED_OPEN standing without treating a settlement record as completed settlement.
Supplies the exact human disposition controlling whether an inheritance record and successor context may be emitted.
carriers.scope: ONE V1 bounded and stacked assemblies.

carriers.role: Separates returned proof from settlement meaning under a bounded validator and schema family.
carriers.scope: Prime-kernel proof harness; the generated mock receipt currently escapes schema validation.

stages.name: Inheritance
stages.definition: Admit exact material into a named successor context only through an independently based disposition while preserving predecessor identity, lineage, and bounded standing.

carriers.role: Separates a decision from its exact standing effect and transactionally idempotent bounded ledger record.
References a physically or structurally present successor whose standing depends on an accepted independent succession decision.
Preserves exact admitted material, predecessor target, independent admission basis, and successor context after ADMIT only.
carriers.scope: Frozen RGCB grammar and ONE V1 bounded assemblies.

stages.notes: The mapped profiles establish bounded ASSIGN and ADMIT behavior. They do not establish general REPLACE or REMOVE semantics, a universal successor-head rule, merge/fork closure, or general path-composition closure.

interstitial_objects.role: Carries exact SourcePoint authorship from Choice into Proposal/Commitment without turning the prior candidate into authority.
Represents the exact proposed crossing bound by TranslationCommitment; Proposal remains distinct from Commitment.
Guards entry from Commitment into Attempt under a profile-specific cardinality and current authority basis.
Binds an occurrence claim to the exact attempt and delta surface before observation.
Joins the semantic candidate path and RuntimeReceipt after Return and before destination assessment/Settlement; Reconstruction is an optional separate region, not a gate prerequisite.
Separates settlement/adjudication from the exact effect later recorded as bounded standing.
Prevents a ReturnObject, ReconstructionObject, or BearingOffer from donating standing to successor context.

projection.source_notation: chi_t = (P_t, C_t, X_t, O_t, E_t, R_t, D_t, I_t)
projection.semantics: An eight-surface projection over the thirteen-burden causal hypergraph. Coordinates contain typed subrecords and may be partial, branching, or unresolved; they are not assumed independent scalar state variables.

coordinates.definition: The live possibility field plus its preparation, provenance, custody, expiry, and invalidation state.
SourcePoint choice and the distinct exact bindings that carry that authorship toward attempted consequence.
Attempt identities, occurrences, and differentiated consequence/delta surfaces.
Bounded attributable observations, coverage, uncertainty, and witness conditions.
Evidence assessments and bundles with their independent admission bases and claim ceilings.
Receipts, ReturnObjects, remainder, lineage, and reconstruction objects or holds.
Judgments, control dispositions, open/unsettled burdens, and exact SourcePoint disposition.
Independently admitted successor material, standing effects, inheritance records, and successor context.

projection.notation_collision_rule: The source symbols are preserved for genealogy but are not machine type identifiers: PBR already uses chi_t^Gamma and P_t for a causal hypergraph, while C_t, X_t, E_t, R_t, D_t, and I_t have other corpus uses. Implementations must use the unabbreviated canonical coordinate names.

known_collisions.description: ONE-RCC binds an admission to one exact authorized attempt; TOP simultaneously describes one bounded attempt and declares zero-to-many ExecutionAttempt records per admission.
Prospective field seal, SourcePoint-authored intent, TranslationCommitment, and ViewBoundCrossingCommit perform different typed bindings at different temporal boundaries.
Semantic translation receipt, runtime receipt, TransitionOccurrenceReceipt, ProofReturnBundle, and ReturnObject have different inputs, ceilings, and downstream roles.
TOP succession adjudication, RGCB open settlement, SourcePoint disposition, and MUS return settlement are related but non-identical profiles; a SettlementRecord is not completed settlement.

The 17-check harness validates the schema and canned examples, then writes a flat mock receipt that omits schema_version, settlement_decision, mus_settlement_receipt, and created_at; that generated payload is never passed to the schema validator.

attack_crosswalk.finding: The semantics explicitly deny promotion, but the prospective front edge is documentation-only and not yet bound to the executable authorship route.
Correspondence and relevance are specified as non-authoritative; the prospective package does not execute its PTR hostile mutations.
Bounded suites reject stale/revoked authority, authority substitution, and candidate-to-intent promotion.
PBR establishes a finite same-endpoint lawful/breached contrast; successful endpoint does not repair the breached path.
The carriers preserve intended, authorized, actual, observed, unobserved, and unresolved delta surfaces instead of a single averaged result.
Observation identity, coverage, and missing/unconfirmed deltas remain bound separately from evidence assessment.
PBR and CHR preserve historical standing and prohibit later resolution from retroactively changing prior validity.
Receipt is separated from evidence admission, truth, settlement, standing, and future permission.
ReconstructionObject cannot create evidence, recovery, authority, disclosure permission, or independent inheritance admission.
Only an exact independent ADMIT path emits inheritance; restart durability or persistence does not.
The shared AttemptAdmission label hides incompatible cardinality semantics and requires a profile split or explicit adapter.
The harness can report PASS while its generated mock settlement receipt is outside the required schema shape.

evidence.claim_ceiling: Human-admitted bounded reference implementation evidence; not production, external-effect, or universal conformance proof.
Conformance to the candidate experimental reference protocol over its supplied fixtures only.

evidence.description: RGCB frozen operator grammar recorded test nodes
evidence.claim_ceiling: Internal consistency of the bounded reference harness; no operator minimality or production claim.
Bounded implementation assurance only; no evidence, disclosure, recovery, settlement, or inheritance effect.
Finite test-only trace-sensitive witness; no general theorem or native two-path completeness claim.

evidence.description: ONE V1 stacked bounded assembly combined suites
evidence.claim_ceiling: Combined finite suites include component tests and are not additive independent proof; the assembly begins at exact AuthoredIntent rather than PreparedPossibilityField.
The run covers schema validity, four examples, and twelve decision fixtures; it does not validate the generated mock receipt, which is currently schema-incompatible.

remaining_seams.description: Bind PreparedPossibilityField/BearingOffer through SourcePointAuthorshipDeclaration and AuthoredIntent into exact RegisterCrossingProposal and TranslationCommitment.
Split or adapt ONE-RCC exact-attempt admission and TOP multi-attempt-envelope semantics; shared spelling is not a type proof.
Bind RuntimeReceipt, ReturnObject/ProofReturnBundle, and settlement artifacts through exact identity and digest-preserving adapters.
Schema-validate the exact mock settlement receipt emitted by write_mock_settlement_receipt and make its shape conform to mus-return-settlement.schema.json.
Run one whole-path hostile conformance route spanning all thirteen burdens; the existing 590-test assembly starts at AuthoredIntent and does not execute the prospective front edge.

source_anchors.claim: This local successor artifact freezes the exact thirteen-burden conformance view and its preserved genealogy.
Defines a non-collapsing minimum artifact spine from proposal through human disposition and STOP; explicitly permits non-serial composition when responsibilities remain recoverable.
States no implicit standing rise, no predecessor-stage absorption, and recoverable compression laws with explicit operator signatures.
Defines the documentation-only GENERATE/PRESERVE/RECOGNIZE/CHOOSE/CROSS prospective composition and denies candidate-to-authority promotion.
Defines the zero-egress PreparedPossibilityField semantic burden, lifecycle, provenance, expiry, and non-conversions without claiming a runtime service.
Defines preparation through SourcePoint choice with authority/effect NONE and no external calls.
Provides executable SourcePoint authorship, AuthoredIntent, return, and inheritance bindings with 49/49 join and 104/104 combined finite tests.

Defines the admitted passage aggregate, typed lifecycle, and explicit separation of operations, occurrences, observations, assessments, judgments, standing, succession, and inheritance without claiming mathematical proof or production conformance.
Freezes an admitted single-edge proposal-to-standing runtime profile and records a 102-test reference specimen.
Defines a candidate, noncanonical, zero-authority potential-to-recognized-successor braid, zero-to-many cardinalities, independent evidence admission, and 16 hostile tests.
Freezes a seven-operator becoming/reconstruction/succession grammar and its non-promotion boundaries with 55 recorded test nodes.
Defines an exact expected-head consequence-time commitment distinct from human or prospective commitment.
Defines a trace-sensitive causal hypergraph view and a 33-test same-endpoint/different-assessment specimen without claiming a general theorem.
Defines a pure bounded reconstruction capability and non-promotion laws with a 70-test implementation surface.
Composes bounded consequence, evidence, proof return, SourcePoint disposition, and conditional inheritance with 77 finite tests.
Composes exact AuthoredIntent through bounded consequence, return, SourcePoint disposition, and conditional successor context; records 590/590 combined finite tests.
Preserves an OPEN settlement and exact route reconstruction in a zero-egress specimen; a recorded settlement is not completed settlement.
Reports 17/17 checks but does not schema-validate the flat mock settlement receipt produced by write_mock_settlement_receipt.
Requires nested settlement_decision and mus_settlement_receipt objects plus schema_version and created_at, which the mock writer does not emit.
